$comment: Public settings for live Sentry mode; none is a secret. MLH fills these in from its Sentry project: dsn from Project Settings > Client Keys (DSN), org and project from the slugs in the project's URL. While any value is still a <placeholder>, the game runs in demo mode. Live mode also needs SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, which the station's vault provides; never put a token here. An optional apiUrl replaces the Sentry API origin, https://sentry.io, with a subdomain of it or a loopback stand-in for tests; the token goes to no other host.
